verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch runs as a headless server. The docs give a scriptable one-liner (`curl -fsSL https://elastic.co/start-local | sh`) that sets up Elasticsearch in Docker for local development or testing. Official client libraries also allow programmatic automation against it. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions/service-container guidance), a documented non-interactive flag or config for start-local, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
